item.title: Thompson Creek from Pisgah Inn - 7.5 Mi, 2400 Ft EG — Mon Oct 12, 8:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This is a down-then-up, out-and-back hike making it harder in my opinion. There are some steep and rocky sections so please be prepared for a harder hike and realize up is the only way back. We will keep a moderate pace but take breaks for water and to look at the views. I will be watching the weather closely this weekend and will cancel if we get too much water. We should have some good fall colors although this year seems a bit muted.
https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/north-carolina/thompson-ridge-trail
**CARPOOL** Let's meet at the French Broad Overlook at 8:30. If you want to go directly to the trailhead, please let me know and use the directions in AllTrails. We will start at the Pisgah Inn parking lot on the NE corner by the MST trailhead at 9am.
**WEATHER** The weather currently might be okay for Monday but I'll watch the weather and post a cancellation message by 7:00 AM if there is a chance of severe weather or lightning during this time period..

item.title: Handmade Holiday: Paper Pamphlets, mighty little books — Fri Nov 6, 10:00 AM
item.description: Handmade Holiday: Paper Pamphlets, Mighty Little Books with Joyce Tromba Friday, November 6 | 10am – 1pm Register Here! In this class you will learn how to make one of the easiest and most versatile book structures: the pamphlet. This book goes all the way back to the 4th century as one of the earliest ways to secure paper and documents. We will explore three different variations of this and look at even more possibilities that are easy to do once you know the basic technique. All materials will be provided in this class. Joyce Tromba is happily settled into life in lovely Western North Carolina after living and teaching around the world for 30 years. Her travels have exposed her to many fiber traditions and she has always found groups of fiber folks wherever she was to share her making with. item.title: Seeing Light: Landscape Photography at the North Carolina Arboretum — Sat Nov 7, 9:00 AM
item.description: Seeing Light: Landscape Photography at the North Carolina Arboretum with Joseph Prater Saturday, November 7 | 9 am – 12 pm Register Here! Participants will explore the Arboretum while learning the fundamentals of landscape photography, including exposure, composition, working with natural light, and recognizing compelling scenes. Instruction is entirely field-based and welcomes photographers of all experience levels, including those using smartphones. This program will take place outside and will follow easy trails and paved walkways. Dress for the weather and prepare to be outside for the entire program time. Joey Prater is a North Carolina-based landscape photographer whose work is inspired by the mountains, forests, and changing seasons of the Southeast. item.title: NOBODY'S DARLING STRING BAND — Sat Nov 28, 4:00 PM
item.description:
Nobody’s Darling String Band plays lively music in the old-time tradition at Jack of the Wood Pub every Saturday afternoon from 4-6pm.
Band Members include Dona Cavanagh, fiddle; Zena Rubin, banjo-uke; Maxine Herring, rhythm guitar; Hilary Dirlam, melody guitar; and Celia Millington-Wyckoff, bass.
The five women comprising Nobody’s Darling each have a long history of playing old-time music. Individually they have played in many other bands through the years, including The Carolina Oldtimers, The Pegtwisters, The Zuma House Band, Too Hot To Cook, The Luke Smathers Mountain Swing Band, Honey Holler, and The Carolina Chick Peas.
Stop in to enjoy the music and an afternoon libation or two, perhaps with an early supper or light bite . . . and don't forget your dancing shoes!
